seo.title: Barber Services & Prices in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Every service at Divinely Faded in Carlsbad, NM with price and time: haircuts, shaves, facials, braids, designs, color and perms. Book on Booksy.

paragraphs: Everything I offer at Divinely Faded, with the price and the time Booksy sets aside for each one. Open any service to read more, or book it straight from the list.
Looking for a specific fade or crop? The style pages show the cuts by name.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The cut, a straight razor neck cleanup and a finished style.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The cut plus your beard trimmed or lined up, a hot towel and razor detailing.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Cut, beard sculpt, wash, steam, two hot towels, waxing and a fragrance finish in one visit.

items.title: Kids' haircuts
items.body: Young clients book from the same menu as everyone else.

blocks.heading: Shaves.
blocks.lead: Hot towels and a straight razor.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: A traditional wet shave with shaving cream and aftershave.

items.title: Head & Beard Shave
items.body: Head and beard shaved smooth, finished with an aftershave balm.

items.title: Express Facial
items.body: Massage, steam, a deep cleanse, exfoliation and moisturizer.

items.title: Deluxe Facial
items.body: The longer facial, with advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.

items.title: Braids
items.body: Personalized braiding. The price depends on the style.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleach and tone to the shade you're after.

items.title: Perm
items.body: Volume, texture and movement, customized to your hair.

items.title: Hair design
items.body: Lines and freestyle shapes cut into the fade.

items.title: Wash & scalp massage
items.body: A wash with a scalp massage.

items.title: Luxury fragrance
items.body: A fragrance finish on the way out.

blocks.heading: Before you book.
paragraphs: Toupee services are coming soon. Beard dyeing and capillary treatments aren't on my menu.
Booksy shows the current price and every open slot when you pick a time.

tim_questions: Can add-ons (wash & scalp massage, fragrance, eyebrows, nose/ear wax) be added to any service, or only to haircuts? The page avoids saying either way.
